name: PUT Then Re-POST Move CompletionDate Step-by-Step Across an AY Boundary
description: SLD POSTs ZSC00001 starting 2026-06-01 (AY 25/26) with no completion date — an open enrolment. Employer approves it. SLD then PUTs the same course, giving it a CompletionDate of 2026-07-31 — still within AY 25/26, no academicYear query param needed. SLD then re-POSTs the same learner/course a second time, this time via the new-style route with academicYear=2627 explicitly appended, moving CompletionDate on to 2026-08-31 — now landing in AY 26/27, all other details unchanged. Extends ay-repost-completion-date-moves-to-next-ay (a single re-POST straight into the next AY) by inserting a same-AY PUT completion update first, then re-POSTing the AY-crossing one — checks that the normal PUT completion path behaves as expected, and whether the already-approved-episode POST guard (CreateDraftShortCourseCommandHandler.HandleSingleItem) still blocks the AY-crossing re-POST as seen in the single-step gap story.

steps.name: SLD Creates Short Course 1 (ZSC00001), Starts June 2026, No Completion/Withdrawal (AY 25/26)
SLD PUTs ZSC00001 with CompletionDate Set to 2026-07-31 (still AY 25/26)
